then.text: Mind your head. And your step. And, if you're heading up the mountain, mind the scree too. It has opinions.
Slate lasts a hundred years if you treat it right. People, rather less. Go up there carefully.
Hard hats on. If you've a mind for another go, my lot have been splitting slate all week and could do with a proper target.

else.text: Once a day, bach. The quarry needs a rest, and so does my back. Come tomorrow.
Another time, then. The offer stands.
Shwmae. Mind the hard hat rule. Yes, even you. Especially you.
Eluned. I look after the Stone Stone, and the quarry it came out of. Both are heavier than they look.
I don't do speeches. Show me what you've got and we'll see how well it's bedded in.
Here. The Stone Stone. Don't drop it on your foot. It's the heaviest thing you'll carry that isn't a regret.
It gives your team Fell-scramble. They'll climb scree, loose slate and mountain paths that look like a bad idea.
There's scree on the way up Yr Wyddfa. Your Fell-scramble gets you over it. That man in the tweed went up there with half a dozen Wardens and a drill. I don't like it.
Go up. And if the mountain asks, I didn't send you. Hwyl.
{player}'s team learned Fell-scramble! Scree slopes can now be climbed.
